caption:
Your team calls a new lead once. No answer. They shrug and move to the next name.

Research on B2B lead follow-up confirms what good closers already know: most reps quit after one or two tries. Reaching someone by phone often takes several more attempts than that.

Run this cadence instead:

1. Text within 5 minutes of the lead coming in
2. Call right after, while the text is still on their screen
3. No answer? Second text at the 1-hour mark, different angle
4. Day 2 morning: call at a new time
5. Day 2 evening: second text
6. Day 3: final call, then move them to a nurture list

Six real attempts across three days catch leads a single call never will.

The Platform fires step 1 automatically and reminds your team the moment each call is due.

rationale: Reels still lead reach for cold-audience teaching content, and this fills an unclaimed gap: the multi-touch cadence for leads who don't answer the first call, distinct from every prior text-back, reminder, or voicemail angle shipped.
